questions.q: What does clicking the question mark icon in Salesforce Setup do?
options: Opens a support ticket automatically
Shows contextual help articles for the exact page you're on, plus Search Help and Get Support
Logs you out and redirects to help.salesforce.com
Only works for System Administrators
questions.explain: The Help and Training menu is context-aware — it surfaces articles relevant to whatever page you're currently viewing, built directly into the product.

questions.q: What is the recommended first stop when you're stuck on a Salesforce admin question?
options: The Trailblazer Community
A Google search
help.salesforce.com, the official documentation
Trailhead modules
questions.explain: Official documentation at help.salesforce.com is the first, most reliable stop for a 'how do I' question before moving to Trailhead or the community.

questions.q: Why check Trailhead's own modules if official documentation already exists?
options: Trailhead modules replace documentation entirely
Trailhead modules often cover the exact feature in more depth than a single help article
Trailhead is only for developers, not admins
Trailhead modules are updated faster than documentation
questions.explain: Trailhead modules walk through features in more depth and with more hands-on context than a single reference article typically provides.

questions.q: What does the Trailblazer Community actually look like in practice?
options: A rarely-used forum with no real activity
Real admins asking genuine questions and getting genuine answers, often linking back to Trailhead modules
A paid support channel only available to Enterprise customers
An AI chatbot that answers Salesforce questions
questions.explain: The community shows real give-and-take between working admins — genuine questions with genuine, often Trailhead-linked, answers.

questions.q: What are Trailblazer Community Groups organized around?
options: Geographic region only
Specific topics and roles people are working on, like Salesforce administration
Paid subscription tiers
Certification exam dates
questions.explain: Groups are built around what members are working on — joining one relevant to administration connects you with others, often tens of thousands, on the same path.
